# Test

Use the repository’s actual checks: `npm run lint` and `npm run build`. For behavior changes, choose focused tests or browser checks only when the repository or task supports them; do not invent coverage claims. Pay special attention to route guards, URL encoding/decoding, share previews, keyboard flow, and responsive UI.
